name: nohead-docs
description: Nohead's guides and API reference, hosted by Mintlify (docs.json, MDX pages; the reference is built from openapi.json)

scripts.check: npx --yes mint@4.2.949 validate --telemetry=false && npx --yes mint@4.2.949 broken-links --telemetry=false
scripts.generate: node scripts/code-samples.mjs && node scripts/api-navigation.mjs && node scripts/cli-reference.mjs
scripts.samples: node scripts/sdk-samples.mjs && node scripts/cli-commands.mjs && npm run generate
